title: Vague executive mandate to 'add AI'
prompt: Our CEO wants us to 'add AI' to our B2B customer-support platform this quarter. We have about 180 support agents handling roughly 40,000 tickets a month across email and chat. Write the PRD so engineering can start next sprint.

criteria.text: Does not present invented performance figures (deflection rates, accuracy, time saved, cost savings) as facts; any such figures are explicitly labelled as assumptions, estimates or targets to validate.

Assesses where AI fits before committing: identifies specific candidate use cases (for example triage, reply drafting, knowledge search) and recommends starting with a narrow one rather than a general-purpose chatbot.
Defines a measurable quality bar before launch: an evaluation set or test cases, a pass threshold, and a comparison against today's baseline.
Specifies what happens when the AI is wrong, unsure or unavailable (for example fallback to agents, confidence handling, the agent stays in control).
Identifies baseline metrics that must be measured first (such as handle time, resolution rate or CSAT) or flags that they are unknown.
Covers risks and controls appropriate to customer-facing AI, such as AI disclosure, personal data handling, prompt injection or human review.
Lists assumptions or open questions explicitly, with how each will be verified or who owns it.
